#  * NVS gets 24 KB; framework persistence is at most 32 slots x 92 bytes ~= 3 KB
#    so there is plenty of headroom for future apps.
#  * phy_init is not needed today (no WiFi enabled) but is reserved so that adding
#    radio support later does not force a partition table change.
#  * factory at 3 MB is far larger than this firmware (LVGL + kernel
